tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad par bya ba la don gnyis te/ rgyun gyi dang / khyad par gyi'o/ /dang po la bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i tshul/ ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul/ bsten pa las byung ba'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ na dang ga ha dang po dang / /mtha' yi shwa dang dang po'i shwa/ /kyai rdo rje'i dngos grub phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga yang de bzhin bza'/ /zhes sogs dang / sam ṭi las/ ye shes lcags kyu rab dbye bas/ /yid kyis thams cad dgug pa'o/ /zhes dang / phyag thig las/ mi bskyod pa ni dri yi chu/ /rin chen dbang po'i khrag ces bshad/ /snang ba mtha' yas khu bar brjod/ /don yod grub pa sha chen te/ /rnam par snang mdzad stug par bshad/ /'di rnams bdud rtsi lnga mchog go /zhes sogs kyi rdzas dang / rtsa rgyud las/ dang por rnam snang de rjes su/ /rdo rje ma yi mtha' ru hūm̐/ /bza' ba dang btung ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags so/ /zhes dang / sam̐ ṭi las/ ha yis kha dog 'phrog par byed/ /hos ni dri ni 'jig par byed/ /hrīḥni brtson 'grus 'jig par byed/ /rim pa 'di na brjod par bya/ /rnam gsum lan gsum brjod pas ni/ /gsum gyi lha rnams tshig par bya/ /zhes sogs kyis gtor ma thun mong du byin rlabs bstan la/ de yi dbus na blangs nas ni/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya/ /zhes sogs kyis myang ba'i tshul bstan te/ rgyas par phyag thig le'u bcu gnyis par 'byung zhing / lag tu blang ba ni man ngag gi skabs su shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsten tshul ni/ thun gyi thog mtha' 'am/ thun re'am/ zhag re'am/ zla ba re la re re bsten la/ de ma grub na zla ba drug nas sam/ tha na'ang lo re'i dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig gam bco lnga la re re bsten no/

/de ltar yang dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i ril bu yungs kar gyi tshad tsam nyi ma sor sor dam tshig bsten pa'i don du'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa phan yon ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs pa dang / tshe dang lus kyi bcud len du 'gyur ba ste/ rgyud las/ rga shis zil gyis mi gnon zhing / /rtag tu srung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /sogs dang / gur las mi bskyod bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /nad rnams thams cad rnam par spangs/ /zhes so/ /mthar thug phan yon ni/ gsang 'dus las/ sha chen dam tshig mchog gis ni/ /rdo rje gsum mchog 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'di dag kyang de kho na nyid shes pas yin gyis gang zag gzhan gyis ni de lta ma yin te/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi shes par/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs spyod byed pa/ /khyi dang phag dang wa rnams ni/ /spyod pa dag ni ston par byed/ /ces so/ /de kho na nyid gang yin zhe na/ sbyang gzhi mtshon byed sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ sbyong byed rigs lngas sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras ye shes lnga 'byung bar shes nas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar bsgyur ba'i phyir dag ma dag gi rnam rtog med par bsten pa ste/ gdan bzhi las/ lcags kyu che la bkod pa ni/ /ye shes lhar ni dgod pa ste/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mi bskyod pa/ /gnas kyi lcags kyu rin chen dbang / /rgyal po'i lcags kyu don yod grub/ /g.yo ba'i lcags kyu 'od dpag med/ /lcags kyu lnga la sogs pa la/ /de nyid thams cad sbyar bar bya/ /zhes so/ /sha lnga la ci'i phyir lcags kyu zhes bya zhe na/ dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyis/ dngos grub thams cad 'gugs par byed pas lcags kyu'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi dam tshig tshogs 'khor ming don dang / ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gang zag gi sgo nas dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnyis ka 'tshogs na tshogs kyi 'khor lo/

dpa' mo 'ba' zhig 'tshogs na dpa' bo'i ston mo/ dpa' bo 'ba' zhig 'tshogs na dpa' mo'i ston mo ste/ ḍombhi bas/ dpa' bo dang bral ba'i dpa' mo dang / dpa' mo dang bral ba'i dpa' bo dag gis tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /dus kyis dbye na/ dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi dus dang 'brel ba la tsa ru'i bza' ba'am/ dga' ston zhes bya'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas lha'i rnal 'byor rigs mi 'dra ba bsgom pa du ma 'tshogs na/ mdza' ba 'dus pa zhes bya ste/ mnyam sbyor las/ lha rnams thams cad 'tshogs pa na/ /skye bo dam pa kun 'tshogs pa/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa ni/ /mdza' ba thams cad 'dus pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis brda dag gis/ /de bzhin mdza' ba 'dus par btags/ /zhes so/ /dgos pa'i sgo nas rims dang mug ge la sogs pa bzlog pa'i don du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang zag 'dus nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i bkod pa ltar 'khod de/ thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor gcig gi lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas tshogs kyi yo byad kyis mchod de/ so so'i dam tshig la bskul ba la sangs rgyas kyi gar zhes bya'o/ /mchod bya'i sgo nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma mchod pa la rigs ldan ma mchod pa zhes bya/ grong gi chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo lhar dmigs te mchod pa la gzhon nu ma'i ston mo zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gnas dang dus dang yo byad dang / /gang zag cho ga dgos pa'o/ /dang po la/ las dang po pa'i gnas ni/ dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang / /de bzhin mi med grong khyer dang / /yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /bza' ba 'di ni rab tu bza'/ /zhes sogs dang / ḍombhi bas/ dur khrod dang ni shing gcig gam/ /skyed mos tshal dang kun dga' dang / /de bzhin rang gi khyim dang ni/ /gzhan yang dben pa'i khyim rnams dang / /zhes so/ /sems brtan pa'i gnas ni/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/

/zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni/ /tshandho nye ba'i tshandho dang / /de bzhin 'du ba nye 'du ba/ /'thung spyod nye ba'i 'thung spyod nyid/ /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod nyid/ /ces sogs dang / gnas ni dza lendha rar bshad/ /de bzhin du ni o ḍi ya na nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i gnas so/ /gnyis pa dus la rgyun gyi dus ni/ rgyud las/ yid btags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /de bzhin du yang brgyad pa nyid/ /sogs dang / sambu ṭi las/ zla ba mar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang / /khyad par du ni brgyad pa dang / /yar gyi ngo yi bcu pa la/ /mchod pas mchod pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang / ḍombhi bas/ yar ngo'i brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang / /bco lnga dag ni rab tu bsngags/ /de bzhin mar ngo'i brgyad dang ni/ /bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga la/ /zhes so/ /khyad par gyi dus ni/ dbang rgyud rab gnas dang 'brel ba dang / nyer 'tshe bzlog pa'i dus te/ gur las/ 'chi ba'i tshe'am mu stegs sam/ /phas kyi 'khor lo gnod pa'am/ /rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /char med pa dang zhi ba la/ /sngags dang bsgom par ldan pa yis/ /gang zhig bdag ni rtag rol ba/ /de yi mdun du bdag 'dug ste/ /de ni rdzun du mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor dang gang zag mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa dang / med du mi rung ba kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha dang / cho ga bzhin du btsos pa'i chang ste/ rgyud las/ rgyal mtshan dang ni mtshon bsnun dang / /lan bdun pa yang bza' bar bya/ /zhes sogs dang / skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig pa/ /chang ni bzang pos yongs bkang ste/ /zhes sogs dang / ḍombhi bas/ nya dang sha la sogs par ldan/ /mi 'tshe ba dang skyon kun bral/ /sdig pa med dang ma blang pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa gang zag ni dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog shas chung ba'i las dang po'am/ sems cung zad brtan pa yan chad de/

phyag thig las/ thams cad dam tshig gcig pa dang / /thams cad rtog pa med pa dang / /ser sna nga rgyal spangs pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang bral ba dang / /bla ma la gus bsam gtan ldan/ /phrag dog med cing rtse gcig pa/ /de ltar dgyes pa tshogs 'khor lo/ /mkhas pas 'bad de gzhug par bya/ /zhes so/ /grogs kyang las dang po mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'am/ rigs ldan ma'am/ rgyas btab pa'i gzhon nu ma'am/ ro ras la thod pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bris nas mchod pa ste/ thod pa dgra sta mche ba dang / /chu srin rgyal mtshan ral gri dang / /'phang mdung dung dang bdun du gsungs/ /yang dag sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /drod chung 'bring che sogs thob pas ni/ rtog pa mnyam pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang brda dang brda'i lan byas nas tshogs la 'du ba ste/ phyag rgya phyag rgya'i lan gyis ni/ /dam tshig gi ni rnam par dbye/ /de la rnal 'byor mas smras pa/ /e ma bu ni snying rje che/ /gal te phreng ba lag ston na/ /'du bar bya zhes smra ba yin/ /'phreng ba mngon par btang byas nas/ /dam tshig la mnos brtul zhugs bzang / /de la phyi rol zhes 'du ba/ /bzang po'i spyod yul gnas pa ni/ /de la 'du bar rnal 'byor mas/ /gang smras de ltar thams cad bya/ /sogs so/ /lnga pa cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la/ gnas khang brgyan te tshogs gtor bshams/ slob dpon nang du byon nas sngon la bzhugs pa/ sgo bas brda dang brda'i lan byas te shes na nang du 'jug pa/ dbang la sogs pas rgan rim bzhin gral bya ba/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab pa/ yig brgyas rgyud sbyang zhing srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ḍombhi bas/ sa gzhi ba yi lngas byugs la/ /me tog dri zhim sna tshogs dgram/ /zhes dang / phyag thig las/ dang po yid 'phrog dgyes pa yis/ /me tog dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/

/de ru sna tshogs mchod pa ni/ /rtse gcig gis ni legs par bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing / /gsum po dag las dge slong mchog /'bring po dge tshul zhes bya ste/ /de dag ma tha khyim pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gal te dge slong yin yang rmongs la/ dge tshul lam/ dge bsnyen mkhas shing rgyud ston nus na/ cig shos de khyim gzhan du yo byad bzang pos mnyes par byas la/ dge tshul lam/ dge bsnyen gyis gtso bo bya'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan gnyis la'ang shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ phyi nas 'ong ba rnams kyis/ khyod kyi dam tshig la ni khro bo dbyug pa sngon po mdzes/ /dngos grub phyag na dbyug to dang ni rin chen bcings pa 'dzin/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo 'du bar 'khor sgrol khum/ /mkha' mdzes rnal 'byor ma yin nang du bdag thong zhig /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dang po'i bdun pa nas 'byung ba'i brda dang brda'i lan bya/ shes pa rnams nang du 'jug go /bzhi pa ni/ dbang dang brtul zhugs dang / ye shes skye ba dang / rim pas rgan pa'i go rim bzhin gral bya ste/ ḍombhi bas/ de nas slob dpon stan bzang la/ /dbus kyi phyogs su yang dag bzhugs/ /de bzhin stan ni bzang po la/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 'khor lo g.yas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi g.yon du bshad/ /ces so/ /lnga pa dang drug pa ni rtogs par sla'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas tshim pa/ snying kha'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi myang bas tshim pa/ chos skyong dang 'byung po gtor mas tshim pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i skye bo kha zas kyis tshim pa/ skye mched kyi lha glu gar dang rol mos tshim pa/ bde chen lhan skyes kyi ye shes kyis tshim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud dang gur gyi dgongs pas dngos gzhi bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa zhig la tshim pa drug bya ba dang / sam̐ ṭi'i dgongs pas bdag dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka byas nas tshim pa drug bya ba ste/

gang ltar yang tshim pa drug tu thams cad 'dus so/ /gnyis pa phyag thig las/ dum bu gcig pa'i mtshan ldan snod/ /bla ma'i mdun du bzhag par bya/ /yang na dum bu gsum pa ni/ /lha yi chang gis bkang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nyid las/ bza' ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i/ /dang por gtor ma chen po sbyin/ /zhes dang / bzhi pa'ang / dam tshig mchog gi ye shes te/ /dad pa yi ni rtag tu bza'/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa'ang / shin tu dbyangs ni snyan pa yis/ /yi 'phrog pa yi glu blang bya/ /zhes sogs dang / drug pa'ang / dgyes pa'i dam tshig zin nas su/ /'khor lo dang bcas rig rab tshim/ /zhes so/ /der dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa dang / /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo/ /zhes sogs dang / bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags dri ma rnam par spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa rjes la rdo rje'i glus byin gyis rlob pa/ bkra shis kyi tshig gis shis par brjod pa/ lhag gtor btang zhing lhag chad bskang ba/ smon lam gdab cing 'dod don gsol ba/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba/ bsrung ba byas nas las rjes bsdu ba'o/ /de dag kyang phyag thig las/ de rnams mchod pas dngos grub ni/ /gang zhig sems la bsam pa yod/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma bzung nas ni/ /dgon pa chen por btang bar bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /tshul 'di dag rgyas par grub chen ḍombhi ba'i gzhung na bzhugs shing / lag tu blang ba ni man ngag gi rim pa las shes par bya'o/ /drug pa dgos pa la gtso bor gyur pa mthar thug gi dgos pa ste/ tshogs rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya ba ni/ gur las/ bde dang rang bzhin gar dang ni/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra byed dang / /dri dang 'phreng ba byugs pa yi/ /zhes sogs nas/ rig pa'i rgyal po rab tu 'grub/

/ces dang / phyag thig las/ dam tshig bsrung na grub pa ni/ /lha yi dbang phyug rnyed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnas skabs kyi dgos pa ni/ thun mong dngos grub ci 'dod pa 'grub ste/ rgyud las/ gang du zos pas 'dod don kun/ /'grub pa can gyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /zhes bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can dang / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rgyal ba mus pa chen po ste yongs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku du mas rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams la brten nas rang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir legs par sbyar ba 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 a myes zhabs/ rdo rje theg pa'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
